inbox.head: gzcoord inbox for {who}: {mine} for you, {others} not addressed to you, on {channel}
inbox.others-header: Not addressed to you — listed, bodies not read (SPEC §17):
delivery.title: --- relay seq {seq}, from {sender}, {when}
cap.notice: [gzcoord: body cut here to fit one notification — the whole message: {replay_cmd} {seq}]
cap.others-count: {count} not addressed to you ({range}), not listed here: over the notification cap.
cap.by-seq: (over the notification cap: each message by its seq, read it with: {replay_cmd} <seq>)
cap.more-for-you: … and {n} more for you ({range}), each read with --replay <seq>
replay.not-addressed: relay seq {seq}, from {sender}, {when} — not addressed to {address}; body not shown (SPEC §17)
replay.title: --- relay seq {seq}, from {sender}, {when} (replay; cursor unchanged)
replay.no-message: gzcoord inbox: no message {which} in the last {n} on {channel}
held.not-a-directory: hold directory is not a directory
held.not-this-login: hold directory is not this login's
config.not-configured: no GZCoord integration configured for {what}: {where} with relay_url and channel, or CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment
config.where-registered: a registered project (this working copy resolves to none)
config.control-channel: {channel} is a control channel: machine records for the control agent (runtime/control/), never a session's inbox or outbox
start.no-token: gzcoord inbox: no CLAUDE_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment, {token_file}, .claude/settings.local.json or the relay runtime dir — skipping
send.presence-offline: send: {address} has no session running — the message would wait in the relay until one starts
send.presence-silent: send: {address}'s control agent did not answer within {seconds} s — whether a session runs there is unknown
send.presence-not-placed: send: {address} is not an account any host places (runtime/hosts/registry.json)
send.presence-no-holder: send: no running session holds {role}; its holders: {holders}
send.presence-some-silent: send: these control agents did not answer or could not tell, and a holder may be among them: {addresses}
send.presence-skipped: send: presence not asked — the relay refused the token in hand; the post says whether it is accepted
send.presence-not-sent: send: not sent — --force sends it anyway
send.presence-planning: send: {address} is planning — its inbox is held until the plan is approved; the message waits in the relay, and no answer comes before then
send.does-not-validate: send: not sent — the message does not validate
send.fallback-reminder: send: reminder — this session fell back from {from_model} to {to_model} at {at} after a safeguard flagged a request as {topic}; filter anything that could be read as {topic_again} out of this message — name where a finding is and what class of problem it is, never its content.
send.from-is-not-this-login: send: FROM is {from} but this session is {address}; not sent — the sender is the login, never a claim
send.id-minted: send: no MESSAGE-ID — minted {id} and wrote it into {file}, so sending the file again sends the same id
send.id-minted-stdin: send: no MESSAGE-ID — minted {id}; from stdin it is kept nowhere, so a retry mints another
send.id-minted-dry: send: no MESSAGE-ID — would mint one (dry run: {id}, not written)
send.id-not-written: send: could not write the minted MESSAGE-ID into {file} ({detail}) — not sent
send.id-reused: send: MESSAGE-ID {id} already went out with a different message (seq {seq}) — a new message needs a new id: delete the MESSAGE-ID line and send again; not sent
send.ledger-not-written: send: sent, but this login's record of sent ids could not be written ({detail}) — a reused id will not be caught
send.would-post: send: would post {type} {id} from {address} to {channel} at {relay_url}
send.no-token: send: no CLAUDE_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment or the working copy — not sent
send.token-refused: send: the relay refused this token (HTTP {status}) — it was rotated; run bin/fabric-secrets sync — not sent
send.relay-unreachable: send: relay unreachable at {relay_url} ({detail}) — not sent
start.relay-unit-silent: {unit} was started and did not answer within 8s; systemctl --user status {unit}, {log}
start.relay-silent: relay did not answer within 8s; check {log}
start.token-retry: gzcoord inbox: token refused; retrying with the synced value from secrets.env
relay.refused: gzcoord inbox: the relay at {relay_url} refused this token (HTTP {status}) — it was rotated; run bin/fabric-secrets sync and re-arm the watch (the inbox reads the synced file itself)
relay.unreachable: gzcoord inbox: relay unreachable at {relay_url} ({detail}) — skipping
watch.held: gzcoord watch: inbox held — the session is planning; nothing is polled until the plan is approved
watch.hold-released: gzcoord watch: hold released; polling again
watch.relay-down: gzcoord watch: relay unreachable at {relay_url} — waiting for it (this line prints once)
watch.relay-back: gzcoord watch: relay is back; watching again
keyword.too-short: keyword {keyword} is shorter than {min} characters — a short token fires on nearly everything
keyword.hit: gzcoord inbox: keyword watch on {channel} — a message matching one of [{keywords}] landed (not addressed to you, metadata only):
validate.retired-type: {type} is retired (SPEC §8): whether an instance is running is presence, not an announcement
validate.reply-expected: REPLY-EXPECTED must be yes or no
validate.broadcast-value: BROADCAST must be true, or absent
validate.no-addressing: missing TO, TO-ROLE or BROADCAST: true
validate.addressing-exclusive: {fields} are exclusive: one addressing field, the delivery scope
validate.request-to-role: a REQUEST is an assignment and goes TO one instance, never TO-ROLE (SPEC §13)
validate.section-to-role: {sections} section makes this an assignment; address it TO one instance, never TO-ROLE (SPEC §13)
validate.sections-to-role: {sections} sections make this an assignment; address it TO one instance, never TO-ROLE (SPEC §13)
validate.forbidden-key: {key} is local/runtime data and forbidden on the wire
validate.role-unknown: ROLE "{role}" is not a role slug in {catalogue}
validate.to-role-unknown: TO-ROLE "{role}" is not a role slug in {catalogue}
validate.role-drift: FROM names {from_slug} but ROLE is {role}; the role may have changed since the clone was named
validate.unparsable-line: unparsable line in the metadata block: {line}
validate.duplicate-key: {key} appears more than once in the metadata block
validate.near-key: {key} is not a known field — did you mean {near}?
validate.id-shaped: {key} carries an id-shaped value ({value}) but is not MESSAGE-ID or IN-REPLY-TO
validate.id-unexpanded: {key} is the literal {value} — the shell variable was not expanded; mint the id with gzmsg.mjs new-id and write its value
validate.id-not-minted: {key} is {value}, not an identifier this deployment mints (a UUID from gzmsg.mjs new-id)
validate.empty-value: {key} has an empty value — a section marker with trailing whitespace reads as metadata
validate.wide-line: line {n} is {width} columns wide; over {max} a terminal copy re-breaks it
wait.nothing: gzcoord inbox: nothing for you on {channel} in {waited}s ({others_passed} passed for others)
